RHAB 540.description: The use of Assistive Technology as it relates to employment, education, communication, recreation, and mobility for individuals with disabiliities. Explores types of assistive technologies, functional assessments, and resources through hands-on application, lectures, and discussions.
RHAB 540.subject: RHAB
RHAB 540.title: Assistive and Adaptive Technology

RHAB 702.description: Foundations underlying research and assessment methodologies and their application to counseling. Research design, program evaluation, ethical principles in research, the scholarly research process, and statistical software packages.
RHAB 702.subject: RHAB
RHAB 702.title: Introduction to Rehabilitation Research and Assessment

RHAB 703.description: Theory, research, and practice which contribute to an understanding of disability; attitudes, psychological, and social factors.
RHAB 703.subject: RHAB
RHAB 703.title: Psychosocial Aspects of Disability

RHAB 704.description: Examines contemporary ethical concerns and issues in rehabilitation counseling profession. The focus will be on attaining a level of applied ethical knowledge and awareness for master’s-level professionals.
RHAB 704.subject: RHAB
RHAB 704.title: Ethics in Rehabilitation Counseling

RHAB 705.description: Concepts and procedures relating to disability and culture, covering relevant issues affecting racially and culturally diverse individuals with disabilities, as well as promoting sensitivity and competence.
RHAB 705.subject: RHAB
RHAB 705.title: Culture and Disability

RHAB 710.description: This course is concerned with imparting medical terminology, the muscular, skeletal, and neurological systems, and common diagnostic categories encountered in rehabilitation counseling. Understanding and utilization of symptomology, treatment, and other management aspects of physical medicine are emphasized. The major outcome is directed toward developing the counselor’s ability to interpret medical information meaningfully to a plan of action for the client’s rehabilitation.
RHAB 710.subject: RHAB
RHAB 710.title: Medical Aspects of Rehabilitation

RHAB 711.description: Individual counseling theory and technique applied to persons with a disability (emotional, psychosocial, mental, and physical) and disadvantaged persons.
RHAB 711.subject: RHAB
RHAB 711.title: Rehabilitation Counseling Practice II

RHAB 712.description: Sequential set of opportunities to acquire and apply knowledge, skills, and insights pertaining to the employment of persons with disabilities.
RHAB 712.subject: RHAB
RHAB 712.title: Occupational Analysis and Placement in Rehabilitation

RHAB 713.description: Career development theories and their relevance to persons with disabilities. Identification of values, interests, abilities, and methods for obtaining, organizing, and utilizing career information to enable career success.
RHAB 713.subject: RHAB
RHAB 713.title: Career Development and Counseling in Rehabilitation

RHAB 714.description: Vocational assessment instruments, methods, materials, and interpretation are applied to a variety of rehabilitation clients. Concepts, skill development, and application of vocational assessment.
RHAB 714.subject: RHAB
RHAB 714.title: Rehabilitation Assessment

RHAB 720.description: Principles and practice of group counseling applied to persons with a disability, or disadvantaged persons.
RHAB 720.subject: RHAB
RHAB 720.title: Group Counseling in Rehabilitation Settings

RHAB 730.description: Focuses on factors which facilitate or deter rehabilitation caseload movement. A detailed task analysis of case intake, case study, individualized written rehabilitation program planning, case services, and case closure within agency procedural regulations are emphasized.
RHAB 730.subject: RHAB
RHAB 730.title: Case Management and Community Resources in Rehabilitation

RHAB 750.description: The application of microcomputers and other technology in services for special populations. Case management, assessment, and instructional uses of technology are included.
RHAB 750.subject: RHAB
RHAB 750.title: Technology and Exceptional Populations

RHAB 752.description: Impact of major disabling conditions on sexual functioning; sex education and counseling of disabled persons.
RHAB 752.subject: RHAB
RHAB 752.title: Disability and Sexuality

RHAB 753.description: Course examines the specialized knowledge and techniques required to rehabilitate persons with severe physical, mental-emotional, and social disabilities.
RHAB 753.subject: RHAB
RHAB 753.title: Rehabilitation and Severe Disability

RHAB 754.description: Counseling approaches with the terminally ill and surviving family members.
RHAB 754.subject: RHAB
RHAB 754.title: Counseling and Death Education

RHAB 880.description: Supervised counseling experience in an approved institution or agency. Official application must be submitted at least one month before the end of the semester preceding enrollment. Supervised counseling experience in an approved institution or agency. Required 150 hours.
RHAB 880.subject: RHAB
RHAB 880.title: Counseling Practicum I

RHAB 883.description: Counseling experience will be gained in a work setting similar to that in which a counselor will eventually be employed.
RHAB 883.subject: RHAB
RHAB 883.title: Counseling Internship
